Install the pinned local model, write a working policy, and run a doctor check.

Requires the binary to be built with `--features setup`.

Usage: gaze setup [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --safety-net <SAFETY_NET>
          Safety-net setup path. Defaults to Nym; `none` keeps NER only; `opf` adds a verified OPF checkpoint for explicit stacked use
          
          [possible values: none, opf, nym]

      --policy-out <POLICY_OUT>
          Policy TOML output path. Defaults to ./gaze.toml

      --model-dir <MODEL_DIR>
          NER model install directory. Defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME/gaze/models/davlan-mbert-ner-hrl

      --no-dob-judge
          Skip the pinned local GLiNER date-of-birth judge, which setup installs and enables by default

      --dob-model-dir <DOB_MODEL_DIR>
          GLiNER bundle directory. Defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME/gaze/models/gliner-multi-pii-dob-int8

      --non-interactive
          Use defaults without prompts

      --force
          Overwrite an existing policy file

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
